verdict.rationale: MX's own marketing describes personalized financial guidance generated from each consumer's financial data, plus a plain-language experience where consumers can ask about their money and act on the answer. That points to first-party insight and suggestion capability, but the support is only short marketing-page lines with no technical documentation or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: developer documentation of the insights/guidance feature, explicit confirmation that the insights are AI-generated, detail on how suggestions are surfaced inside the product, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Personalized financial guidance generated from each consumer's financial data, surfaced in a relevant and timely experience
Provide an experience where consumers can ask about their money in plain language and act on the answer, with every figure pulled from real permissioned data.
Use data-driven intelligence about your customers
